sections.text:
Wisdom Oracle is a spiritual reading web app that brings together two timeless sources of wisdom:
Bhagavad Gītā As It Is — 1972 Unabridged Edition (Macmillan)
I Ching / Book of Changes — Richard Wilhelm translation Explore both oracles with a random verse or hexagram, or look up specific chapters and numbers. Clean, dark-themed interface — no ads, no distractions.

sections.list: Fully offline — once cached, works without internet. Perfect for airplane mode. Auto-updates — service worker fetches improvements silently in the background. Share or copy any verse or hexagram directly from the card view. Installable — add to home screen and open like a native app.

Developer: WebKide Library: html2canvas.min.js — shareable PNG cards Data: JSON files stored locally, no external requests Repository: GitHub · WebKide/gitawisdom Live URL: webkide.github.io/gitawisdom

footer:
No accounts, subscriptions or personal data required.
Responsive design for desktop and mobile.
Runs entirely in your browser.
